description: The line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” across four different model-benchmark combinations as a function of an increasing x-axis value ranging from 128 to 1024, likely representing input context length or token count. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” spans from 0.0 to 0.5 in linear increments of 0.1. Four distinct lines are plotted: (1) LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line) starts at ~0.20 at x=128, rises to ~0.25 at x=256, then plateaus near ~0.35 from x=512 to x=1024; (2) Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line) begins at ~0.15 at x=128, increases to ~0.24 at x=256, jumps to ~0.42 at x=512, and remains flat at ~0.42 through x=1024; (3) LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line) starts at ~0.06 at x=128, climbs to ~0.21 at x=256, reaches ~0.37 at x=512, and slightly increases to ~0.38 at x=1024; (4) Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line) begins at ~0.24 at x=128, rises to ~0.27 at x=256, jumps to ~0.42 at x=512, and continues increasing to ~0.52 at x=1024. All lines show an upward trend with varying degrees of acceleration and plateauing behavior, indicating that the harmful refusal ratio generally increases with larger context sizes, with Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench exhibiting the steepest final rise.
